curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What happens when an anonymous artist famous for avoiding cameras decides to direct the very man trying to capture him?
curatedMovie.description: An eccentric French shopkeeper attempts to track down and film elusive street artist Banksy, who fiercely guards his anonymity until the tables turn and the camera is pointed back at the filmmaker.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Smart, funny, and briskly paced, offering an engaging true-story watch that sparks immediate conversation.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Banksy himself, this nimble 86-minute documentary blends mischievous wit with sharp questions about modern art, fame, and who controls the story.
